Context
-------
Read .github/copilot-instructions.md, README-FIRST.md, and check for
existing feedback/airgap-run-*.md files (none expected yet).

The learner-VM workflow is now repo-only. The operator transfers the
repository, sets K3S_BINARY_URL on the VM, and runs
scripts/00-diagnose.sh first. README-FIRST.md instructs the operator
to transcribe the diagnostic's REPORT block into
feedback/airgap-run-001.md, but that file does not exist yet.

This task runs on the connected machine. Do not access the learner
VM.

Also apply one small correction to content/vendor/MANUAL-FETCH.md:
in Section C, the sentence beginning "Scripts 20 and 30 also fetch
RHEL packages…" is inaccurate — script 30 is CA and trust
installation, not package fetching. The RHEL package and repository
metadata fetch is script 20 only. Reword the sentence accordingly.
Leave the rest of the file as it is.

Objective
---------
Create the feedback scaffold so transcriptions are consistent and
machine-parseable in later agent runs.

Deliverables
------------
1. feedback/README.md
2. feedback/airgap-run-template.md
3. feedback/airgap-run-001.md — pre-filled metadata, empty report
   block awaiting the operator

feedback/README.md — one page:
  - purpose of the feedback directory
  - naming: airgap-run-00N.md, incrementing per VM run
  - rule: transcribe verbatim; paste the complete REPORT BEGIN/END
    block; observations go outside the block; do not summarise or
    replace evidence with prose
  - "the agent reads these newest-first before changing any learner-VM
    script or 00-diagnose"
  - standard metadata fields for every record: date, operator, VM
    RHEL version, repository commit SHA, lab-vm.conf deviations from
    defaults, whether K3S_BINARY_URL is set (yes/no — do not paste
    the URL value), SCRIPT_VERSION values run, VM-side commands run
  - interpretation guidance:
      * EXPECTED at this stage: SKIPPED / ARROW lines about packages
        not yet installed, network not yet configured, k3s not yet
        installed, K3S_BINARY_URL unset — all normal on a fresh
        minimal base
      * FAIL lines worth escalating: registry/Artifactory unreachable
        at $DOCKER_REGISTRY, CA not in the OS trust store, DNF repo
        failures, ISO mount failures, missing in-repo content, payload
        checksum mismatch on the manually staged binary
      * Paste the block even when it contains fails — the fails are
        the point of the scaffold, not a reason to hide the block
  - a pointer to airgap-run-template.md

feedback/airgap-run-template.md — same structure as
airgap-run-001.md below, every field empty, a one-line description
above each field.

feedback/airgap-run-001.md — pre-filled metadata only where stated;
the report block is empty:

  # Airgap run 001 — 00-diagnose

  ## Metadata
  - Date: <operator fills in>
  - Operator: <operator fills in>
  - VM / RHEL version: <operator fills in>
  - Repository commit SHA: <operator runs `git rev-parse HEAD` in
    the cloned repository and pastes the result>
  - Transfer method (how the repo reached the airgapped network):
    <operator fills in>
  - lab-vm.conf deviations from defaults: <operator fills in>
  - K3S_BINARY_URL set: <yes | no — do not paste the URL value>
  - Script versions run: 00-diagnose v4
  - Purpose of this run: confirm environment before provisioning

  ## Report block

  <operator pastes the complete REPORT BEGIN/END block here,
   verbatim, as a single block>

  ## Operator observations
  <anything outside the block: what they noticed, timing, prompts
  they had to answer, unexpected messages>

  ## Follow-up required
  <whether 10-preflight will be run next, any blocker>

## Constraints
- Do not modify provisioning scripts, lab-vm.conf, README-FIRST.md,
MANUAL-FETCH.md (other than the one Section C correction above),
or manual-fetch.json.
- Do not pre-fill any report block content. An obviously empty
placeholder line is required, not fabricated output.
- If feedback/airgap-run-001.md already exists, increment to the
next free number and say so.
- Do not stage or commit unless explicitly asked.
## Validation (connected machine only)
- Confirm all three feedback files exist.
- Confirm the report block placeholder is clearly empty and marked.
- Confirm feedback/README.md names the protocol rules and the
interpretation guidance in full.
- Confirm the Section C correction is applied and no other
MANUAL-FETCH.md content changed.
## Acceptance
1. Paste all three feedback files in full.
2. Paste the corrected Section C paragraph from MANUAL-FETCH.md.
3. Confirm no provisioning script, lab-vm.conf, or README-FIRST.md
was modified.
4. Confirm the learner VM was not accessed and the diagnostic has
not been run.
5. Leave changes uncommitted and unstaged.
